notes.title: Out of Early Access
notes.content:
It's the one year anniversery of The Monster Within releasing into early access! And we're celebrating that with the gaming coming out of early access! Yes, this is the full release! All ten monsters, all ten mashups, almost 400 cards, almost 50 afflictions, less bugs (hopefully), it's all here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/cdc08f400cc925ac00ddac1b0e82e24e0f6d299d.png[/img]

Thank you so much to everyone who's bought and played the game so far. None of this would be possible without you. This game has been a labor of love from both the artist and I, and we've done out best to make it as enjoyable and fun as possible. In the end, it's up to you to decide if we succeeded. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/6542759a25ae24f9332bfe9dc901ada141f9f713.png[/img]

2.0:

New Content:
Added new monster, Cultist
Added monster new theme pack, CultistEX
Added new Cultist-Warlock monster, Mummy
Added new Cultist-Werewolf monster, Lunatic
Added new Shapeshifter-Parasite monster, Doppleganger
Added new Mad Scientist-Wraith monster, Homunclus
5 new Afflictions, 1 generic, 2 for Shapeshifter, and 2 for Cultist

Bug Fixes:
A lot. I kind of stopped keeping track.

So now that the game is out of early access, what's the plan for the future? Well, there's a few features that had to be cut for time. Blood level 10 and the final boss didn't make the cut. There's some planned card sets that didn't make it in either. And a good amount of skits that don't exist that should. Will this stuff be added eventually? Hopefully, it kind of depends on demand. The skits definitely, that was just me running out of time. We've spent a lot of time on this game and if people really want more, we'll provide it. But both the artist and I feel like moving on.

What's next for GMO Free Games? Well, we made a deck building card game about 1950's horror comics, so the next obvious step is... a pixel art game about guiding a princess that's a direct homage to Princess Maker II and mid-90's PC games! Basically same genre and aesthetic, I'm sure there will be no consumer confusion at all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/e4a447f46a9ace25b63f4324e98959b19e5fbf3a.gif[/img]
Coming in about a year, whatever this game ends up being called!

Thanks again to all our players, we love each and everyone of you.

notes.title: Out of the Shadows
notes.content:
It's been a month since Shapeshifter came out and we've been hard at work to keep up the momentum and finish the game. We've been in early access for a year, but the light at the end of the tunnel is almost here! Just a few more weeks and that tag will be gone from the game. We're talking full release!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/ebd7efe151f186f423fc93225177044033d67638.png[/img]
The final monster for The Monster Within is almost here, the Cultist! This won't be the final update, but it will be the last big content release. Maybe. We'll see what the future holds but we here at GMO Free Games are kind of monster'd out after working on this project for almost three years at this point. 

So who is the Cultist? She's a character we've saved for the end because she's kind of complex. Like Werewolf she has two forms, pure and corrupted. But unlike Werewolf, you don't choose when you switch back and forth.

Instead, each turn you'll gain corruption. You have cards that reduce it, but if you don't eventually she'll be overcome with the ancient, evil energies she's been fighting against and become it's servant!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/20e0d0faf1fa16d09d30e6dc5b787a1972545301.png[/img]
When that happens, all Cultist cards change. Different art, different effects, different costs, it's like become a completely different character. Instead of reducing corruption, you get payoffs for fostering it. Pure Cultist is a day focused character, while cultist is night/monster based. You can try to stay untainted, or intentionally let corruption build up to get to the corrupted form faster. Maybe you'll buy certain cards when pure you don't need right then, but will have beneficial effects when corrupt. There's all sorts of ways to play it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/7a4376f5585daf1d7caf777832a7577445176f19.png[/img] 
Also coming in the final update is the final four mashup monsters. Doppleganger (Parasite-Shapeshifter), Mummy (Warlock-Cultist), Homunculus (Mad Scientist-Wraith), and Lunatic (Cultist-Werewolf)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/e0f3b28d40f759fc27dbf06f1ef969e307b84686.png[/img]
There's a lot of work still to be done here. The delay with Shapeshifter messed up our timelines a lot. Worst case, a few features will be missing from the full release we'll patch in later. But we're pretty committed to getting it our for Halloween. Thanks to everyone who has played and enjoyed the game this past year, we're almost to the finish line!

notes.title: The Shapeshifter Update
notes.content:
After a two month delay, she's finally here! The Shapeshifter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/cb46cfb624460c99be349dbc18e96bea3ff8e629.png[/img]
The Shapeshifter works differently from any other monster in the game. Your health level doesn't matter for seeing her cards. All that matters is how many form points you buy.

Ghoul points seed cards that generate Night.
Bear points seed cards that generate Shield.
Snake points seed cards that generate Attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/1a356fbd0e32fdfbec633a14d45364b050f68677.png[/img]
Put it all together and you can build your Shapeshifter anyway you like!

Also in this update is the Blob-Shapeshifter mashup monster, the Morphling! This adds a fourth form, Goop. Goop cards generate Monster points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/208fcc1afe141ea22058c117ab6a4bf41567a65a.png[/img]


1.4:

New Content:
Added new monster, Shapeshifter
Added monster new theme pack, ShapeshifterEX
Added new Blob-Shapeshifter monster, Morphling

Changes and Bug Fixes:
The game now auto generates backup saves at the start of your play session. If losing power causes your save to be corrupted, you can manually replace the corrupted save with the backup. This is a temporary stopgap measure and we hope to be able to find a solution to the save corruption in the future.
Waxing Anger, Two Wolves, and Rush of Adrenaline now only have an effect if you're at less than 50 health. This will stop you from gaining negative resources if playing them at a higher health level

Because of the delay, Cultist will now be coming out in the final update of the game bringing it out of early access this October. The full roster of ten Monsters and all ten Mashups will be ready to paint the town red this Halloween!

notes.title: Fashionably Late
notes.content:
Where's Shapeshifter?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/48132983714206130dcb32d222e4432cccd863d3.png[/img]

Yes, Shapeshifter should have been out already. But unfortunately, the game's amazing and talented artist has been sick and unable to make said amazing art lately. Unless people are okay with a shift in artistic direction to the drawing above, it'll still be a little bit.

Shapeshifter as a monster has more art needs than any before with her unique mechanics, so until that cool art is done, she'll remain lurking behind the scenes. She could be anywhere, anyone...

So let's talk about what the Shapeshifter actually is as a character. As the shapeshifter, you can spend your Day/Night/Monster on form points. How many of the form points you have represents what shape you're shifting into. Cards for that form will only show up as you buy form points, the more you buy the more and better cards you'll see.

There's three forms; Serpent, Bear, and Ghoul. Serpent form is all about striking your foe with deadly speed, so if you're after attack, that's the form to go after. On the opposite end, Bear form is all about enduring damage. If your foe can't hurt you, well they're not in for a good time. So Bear form's cards give you lots of shield. Ghoul form is the form of cunning and underhanded dealings. Hiding in the shadows you'll gain the resources you need to take down any who oppose you. Night generation will be a piece of cake if you specialize as the Ghoul.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/90f2a256dd69aee94b4c5d9b90f36954c0a04b64.png[/img] 
https://www.instagram.com/artistrayph/ Art by Artistrayph

But you don't have to go all on on one of the three, you can mix and match as you please. All of Shapeshifter's cards can be bought with any resource, so she can played at any health level you like. But she plays best with Night cards as the only resource she can generate to buy things are Night points with the Ghoul.

But those three forms aren't the only ones you'll get to play with in the update. There's also the Shapeshifter-Blob mashup monster, the Morphling! Who needs to hold a definitive form when you can be a mass of goo that can take whatever shape it wants. With Goop form you won't be very strong, or resilient to damage, or cunning, but you will be very monstery! Become the biggest and goopiest ball of slime you can and show them what a real monster looks like.

We don't have a definitive timeline for when Shapeshifter will be done, but we hope she'll be showing her faces by the end of July.

notes.title: Dark Omens
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/7bd751aa7e9660539644afffa8ff4b009b11e2f9.jpg[/img]

I hope everyone has been enjoying the Werewolf . But people who turn into wolves is so 17th century. It's time for a new, hip monster who all the kids will love. The Warlock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/16e5e892f4648bd354a45afc94e27b995d73b839.png[/img]

Look at him in his priest robes, the 12-16 demographic are going to love him. The Warlock is all about drawing power from your demonic benefactors and casting spells. Spells are a special kind of effect that don't trigger until the start of your next turn. If a card says Spell: 2 Attack, that means you gain that attack next turn. And spells happen in the order you played them. So if you play a spell that gives you double attack this turn, then play one that gives you 2 attack, you end up with 4 attack! And then if you have an effect that recasts your spells... well you can get up to all kinds of combos.

Warlock is a fairly standard monster in terms of what health his cards show up at. Some Night cards, some Monster cards, he plays similarly to the Vampire and the Blob except instead of trying to keep a counter up or down, you're trying to set up big combo plays. But if you want to cast some spells in broad daylight, you're in luck with his first mashup monster...

Deep from out the bayou comes the Swampkin! The Plant's second mashup monster,  with this monster a new suite of day focused spells are added to your magical arsenal. This will make Plant the second monster with both of its mashups. Do you want to play as the Zombie or the Swampkin, the choice is yours!

I hope everyone enjoys the Warlock when he comes to The Monster Within at the end of April. What, isn't it already April? Better get back to work!

notes.title: New Moon Rising
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/9a61889b0b1bad8e6990271d6cf424da0910e11a.png[/img]

Happy Lunar New Year from everyone here at GMO Free Games (all two of us)! With the rising of a new moon, comes a new monster. One who lives and dies by the phase of the moon...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/f5d57b60a899c435367d019946fbe3757147103a.png[/img]

It's the Werewolf! The Werewolf is a monster who's mechanic is based on forms. When the full moon is out, he transforms into a vicious beast, when it's not, he walks the streets in as a seemingly normal man. In game, this is represented by most of his cards working in one state or another. You can pull off powerful and under costed effects, but you have to balance having enough cards that change the phase of the moon to be able to use them all consistently. 

Werewolf is also the opposite of the Parasite in a way, in that he loves having lots of monster cards and being at very low health. In fact, Werewolf can actually increase his minimum health to survive at monstrous states that would be impossible for any other character. As long a glimmer of the man inside is around he can continue to hunt to his hearts content.

Also coming with this update is his first monster mashup with...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/0600cdf07abd6f67b3159024b7a6c9f8670fdc46.png[/img]

The Vampire! The legendary Werepire is here, ready to feed on the blood of any who oppose them. This also means the Vampire is the first monster to have two mashups to choose from. Having two mashups is the goal for all monsters eventually.

I hope everyone enjoys the Werewolf when he comes to The Monster Within later this month.

notes.title: The Monster Mash-Up Update
notes.content:
As the content roadmap foretold, the December update is here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/4a6207c708bfc2c796ff2edc4a566479498ce8ba.jpg[/img]
Featuring three mash-ups of the monster you already know. The Lich, a combination of Vampire and Wraith, the Abomination, a combination of Blob and Mad Scientist, and the Zombie, a combination of Plant and Parasite.

Eventually all monsters will have two different options, for a total of ten mash-up monsters. But for now here's three to get started!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/c2d194b705ad2585df0c52856a43dc82e18c1353.jpg[/img]
Take your pick!

But that's not all, there's also three new theme packs in this update, unlocked by winning with the mash-up monsters. Here's a full list of the changes:

1.1:

New Content:
Added round four, the monster mash-up round	
Added the Lich mash-up monster. Combines the Vampire and the Wraith	
Added the Abomination mash-up monster. Combines the Blob and the Mad Scientist	
Added the Zombie mash-up monster. Combines the Plant and the Parasite	
Added new Day theme pack, News.	
Added new Night theme pack, Divination	
Added new Monster theme pack, Ruthless	
Added Werewolf, Warlock and Shapeshifter monsters as bosses in round 4 (this is because they are an alternate mash-up for some of the playable monsters and you always fight the one you don't use.)	

Balance Changes:
Raised starting paper to 50	
Lowered enemy health scaling between rounds slightly	

The mash-up round drastically changes how the game plays, with a lot more focus on monster specific mechanics and their interactions and less on generic theme packs. Instead of 13 monster specific cards  in the pool, you'll have 31! That means almost half of the cards the Wraith has access to, the Abomination or Zombie doesn't and vice-versa. So get to blood 5, get to round four, and try them out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/42d3a33678d4258820fe492715ca71293aee71dc.png[/img]
Art by Fulminaire. https://twitter.com/Fulminaire03

notes.title: Update to 1.0.7 and new content Previews
notes.content:
When we showed the content roadmap, we left a teaser for one of the new monsters in the Monster Mash-up round. Well here it is!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/00633fc5f8e00dc077b88056b55967959e9e8537.jpg[/img]

In the new round, you play as two monsters at once! In this case, the Vampire, and the Wraith. You'll have acsess to all the cards of both monsters as well as some special cards that are specific to that mash-up, like this one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/c3bb62567ed9813f83fabdfd624f4770c7891b31.png[/img]

Most of these cards interact with both monster mechanics. If you can balance it well, you can set up new and powerful combos beyond what any monster could do on their own! Each monster will have two different mash-ups, although to start there will only be one each. 

Since it's already December 17th, and the update comes out this month, that means it's getting pretty darn close! How close you'll find out soon. In the mean time...

notes.title: The Monster Within Roadmap
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who's been playing The Monster Within so far. We've gotten a lot of great feedback and reviews, and we here at GMO Free Games (all two of us) have loved seeing people play and enjoy our game. We've finalized our content release schedule and are ready to reveal what's upcoming for The Monster Within.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/c6523871d894d2993f2a9142258f969358e92211.png[/img]

The plan is to leave early access next Halloween. Before that, we've going to introduce four more monsters, a lot of new theme packs, and more! The next release is the Monster Mash-up round. On Blood level 5 or higher, after you beat round 3 the game isn't over yet, it's time to go even further in your monstrous transformation! Every monster will eventually have two others it can pair up with to create a new mash-up monster that's a combination of the two. For example, as the Vampire you can choose to mash-up with the Wraith to create...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41259909/54b6172159ebe8da695ca1a05c70fbd30ecc89a3.png[/img]

Well... you'll just have to wait and see. In 1.1, we're going to introduce the first three Monster Mash-ups, so every monster will be able to play round 4. In the Monster Mash-up round, you play with both monster's cards and mechanics at the same time! Each mash-up also includes it's own unique cards specific to that combination. Also coming in 1.1 is three new card packs to increase the level of depth and customization even more.

Also releasing today is update 1.0.5 with the following changes:

Gameplay Changes:
Changed the blood levels 1, 2, 3
1 is now "Enemies have +25 health and traits" from "Basic enemies have +25 health and traits" (Now includes bosses)
2 is now "Basic enemy damage scales faster" from "Bosses have +25 health"
3 is now "Limited amount of paper per round" from "Basic enemy damage scales faster"

New mechanic: paper
Whenever the comic book is refreshed, either from starting a new turn or playing enough cards to fill it, you use one sheet of paper. If you run out of paper you start taking damage every time you use some.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed a big with Heliophobia and Nyctophobia that caused the permanent buy card and your basic cards to transition at the wrong time
Fixed the health shown on the win round screen applying the boss's damage on the turn you win
Expanded unlock verifier to read theme packs if they somehow go missing


The new paper mechanic should make strategies that try to play their whole deck every turn or stall before the boss for dozens of turns less dominant. Be careful how many cards you play every turn, yo don't want to blow through your whole paper supply too fast or you'll be in a world of hurt!
